programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and Willie Nelson / Mr. Monk und Willie Nelson
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FudBal - Copa Libertadores / Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: The "Copa Libertadores" is the annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition changed, of which only the champions in their leagions have the right to perform until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FudBal - Copa Libertadores / Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: The "Copa Libertadores" is the annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition changed, of which only the champions in their leagions have the right to perform until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga

The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football: UEFA European Women's Championship 2025: quarterfinals: Sweden - England / Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Четвъртфинал: Швеция - Англия
programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. The team of England will defend its title, won 3 years ago on home land. The biggest competitors are the world champions from Spain, who are the team with the most front ranking in Europe in the FIFA rankings- second place. The German squad, which lost the final 3 years ago, is a record holder for European victories, triumphed 8 times in the previous 13 editions, but their last title has been in 2013 in the top ten of the world rankings are the teams of Sweden and France. / 16-те най-добри дамски отбора на континента се събират в Швейцария, за да се борят за купата в 14-ия европейски шампионат. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. В първата десетка на световната ранглиста са още отборите на Швеция и Франция.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Antoaneta Frankeva / Зала на славата: Антоанета Френкева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.desc: A man who experienced all the horrors of Auschwitz on his own skin goes hunting for a person who is to blame for the death of his family. Unfortunately, time took its toll and its memory is no longer as it was. / Muškarac koji je na vlastitoj koži iskusio sve užase Auschwitza kreće u lov na osobu koja je kriva za smrt njegove obitelji. Nažalost, vrijeme je uzelo svoj danak i njegovo sjećanje nije više kao što je bilo.

programme.title: Dinamo Zagreb - Celtic, Football, Champions League / Dinamo Zagreb - Celtic, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2024) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a Cup of Champions was founded, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2024) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. programme.title: PSG - Tottenham, Football: UEFA Super Cup / Psg - Tottenham, Nogomet: UEFA Superkup
programme.desc: The UEFA Super Cup - (Sport. Program, 2025) UEFA European Super Cup is a trophy, for which the winners of two club continental competitions, the Champions League and the Europa League are fighting. The European Super Cup traditionally begins the season of European club competitions. The first supercomba was played in 1973 and the winner was Ajax. The teams with the most won titles are Spanish Barcelona and Italian Milan. By far the most title is held by the Spanish team ... / UEFA Super Cup - (sport. program, 2025) UEFA europski superkup trofej je za koji se bore pobjednici dvaju klupskih kontinentalnih natjecanja, Lige prvaka i Europske lige. Europskim superkupom tradicionalno započinje sezona europskih klupskih natjecanja. Prvi Superkup igran je 1973. godine, a osvajač je bio Ajax. Momčadi s najviše osvojenih naslova su španjolska Barcelona i talijanski Milan. Daleko najviše naslova drže španjolske momčadi...

programme.title: Gutersloh - Union Berlin, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Rumunjska - Hrvatska, Odbojka, Kvalifikacije za Europsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: CEV Volleyball Womens European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Europsko odbojkaško prvenstvo za žene je službeno natjecanje europskih država koje se organizira pod okriljem Europske odbojkaške federacije (CEV). Uvertira u sami turni su kvalifikacije za zemlje koje nisu osigurale plasman na završni turnir kroz prethodno natjecanje ili nisu domaćini koji imaju pravo na direktan plasman. Kvalifikacije su isto pod ingerencijom CEVa. Ovisno o broju sudionika sami format kvalifikacija se mijenjao kroz godine. Od prvenstva 2019. godine završni turni broji 24 nacije tako da su reprezentacije koje sudjeluju u kvalifikacijama koncipirane u više skupina sa po četiri momčadi te dvije najbolje rangirane reprezentacije unutar svake grupe osiguravaju pravo sudjelovanja na završnom turniru...

programme.desc: The UEFA Super Cup - (Sport. Program, 2025) UEFA European Super Cup is a trophy, for which the winners of two club continental competitions, the Champions League and the Europa League are fighting. The European Super Cup traditionally begins the season of European club competitions. The first supercomba was played in 1973 and the winner was Ajax. The teams with the most won titles are Spanish Barcelona and Italian Milan. By far the most title is held by the Spanish team ... / UEFA Super Cup - (sport. program, 2025) UEFA europski superkup trofej je za koji se bore pobjednici dvaju klupskih kontinentalnih natjecanja, Lige prvaka i Europske lige. Europskim superkupom tradicionalno započinje sezona europskih klupskih natjecanja. Prvi Superkup igran je 1973. godine, a osvajač je bio Ajax. programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Sassuolo - Catanzaro, Nogomet, Coppa Italia
programme.desc: Coppa Italia - (sport. program, Italija, 2025) Talijanski kup svoju povijest kroji od 1922. godine i svog prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej momčadi sa Apeninskog poluotoka su trebali pričekati do 1936. godine kada se natjecanje opet počelo održavati i održava se svake godine. Pomalo kuriozitetan podatak je slabija posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na Serie A zbog tradicije odmaranja ponajboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih momčadi. No, sve to pada u vodu prilikom završnice turnira kada se pobjedniku osigurava sigurno mjesto u skupinama UEFA Europa lige. Tada interes za ovo natjecanje rapidno raste. Pravi ljubitelj talijanskog nogometa će sigurno popratiti ovo natjecanje!...

programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. programme.title: Rumunjska - Hrvatska, Odbojka, Kvalifikacije za Europsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: CEV Volleyball Womens European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Europsko odbojkaško prvenstvo za žene je službeno natjecanje europskih država koje se organizira pod okriljem Europske odbojkaške federacije (CEV). Uvertira u sami turni su kvalifikacije za zemlje koje nisu osigurale plasman na završni turnir kroz prethodno natjecanje ili nisu domaćini koji imaju pravo na direktan plasman. Kvalifikacije su isto pod ingerencijom CEVa. Ovisno o broju sudionika sami format kvalifikacija se mijenjao kroz godine. Od prvenstva 2019. godine završni turni broji 24 nacije tako da su reprezentacije koje sudjeluju u kvalifikacijama koncipirane u više skupina sa po četiri momčadi te dvije najbolje rangirane reprezentacije unutar svake grupe osiguravaju pravo sudjelovanja na završnom turniru...

programme.title: Real Madrid - Arsenal, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a champion Cup was established, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Chelsea - Legia, Nogomet, Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: UEFA Conference League - (sport. program, 2025) Od 2021. godine ljubitelji nogometa uživaju u Ligi Konferencija koju organizira UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane momčadi državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u natjecanje ulaze 32 ekipe koje su podijeljene u osam skupina po četiri. 16 momčadi napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale...

programme.title: Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Dynamo - Vukovar 1991, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 2nd round / Dinamo - Vukovar 1991, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 2. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Rijeka - Shelbourne, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / Rijeka - Shelbourne, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: Shakespeare - Dramatikkens mester
programme.desc: How did William Shakespeare become one of history's greatest literary icons? This 2024 British documentary dives into the playwright's life and time-from the modest roots of Stratford-upon-Avon to fame, tragedy and political intrigue in Elizabethan London. Through historians, actors and experts, we get a nuanced portrait of man behind the works - his ambitions, his struggles and his eternal pursuit of immortality through the magic of theater. / Hvordan blev William Shakespeare et af historiens største litterære ikoner? Denne britiske dokumentarserie fra 2024 dykker ned i dramatikerens liv og tid – fra de beskedne rødder i Stratford-upon-Avon til berømmelse, tragedie og politisk intrige i det elizabethanske London. Gennem historikere, skuespillere og eksperter får vi et nuanceret portræt af mennesket bag værkerne – hans ambitioner, hans kampe og hans evige jagt på udødelighed gennem teatrets magi.

programme.title: I magtens korridorer
programme.desc: Politiske insidere og ledere afslører, hvordan Amerikas mest magtfulde har håndteret chokerende rapporter om folkedrab og krigsforbrydelser.

programme.title: De sidste dage i Afghanistan
programme.desc: In August 2021, the Taliban storms in Afghanistan and quickly occupies the capital Kabul. The Western evacuation is chaotic. But what happened in twenty years since Osama bin Laden and al-Queda's terrorist attack in the United States on September 11, 2001? / I august 2021 stormer Taliban frem i Afghanistan og indtager hurtigt hovedstaden Kabul. Den vestlige evakuering er kaotisk. Men hvad er der sket i løbet af tyve år siden Osama bin Laden og al-Quedas terrorangreb i USA d. 11. sept. 2001?

programme.desc: In the series we learn about Japan's role in World War II. What was Japan striving for in the war and what was it like to live in Japan in moments of victory and defeat? Hvad stræbte Japan efter i krigen, og hvordan var det at leve i Japan i øjeblikke med sejr og nederlag? Serien indeholder masser af sjældent arkivmateriale og ekspertinterviews.

programme.title: Arkitektens hjem
programme.desc: Architects work on a daily basis to design housing for others, but how do they live themselves? programme.title: Den klassiske musikquiz
programme.desc: How hard is it to recognize music played from behind? Can you play orchestra music on percussion instruments? And is it at all possible to decide a piece of music after just a single tone? Frederik Cilius and Mathias Hammer are the team captains who control the evening's two teams through the challenges. The DR Symphony Orchestra and conductor Thomas Søndergård stand for the music, while Phillip Faber is the obvious host trying to keep track of the lies. / Hvor svært er det at genkende musik spillet bagfra? Kan man spille orkestermusik på slagtøjsinstrumenter? Og er det overhovedet muligt at bestemme et stykke musik efter bare en enkelt tone? Frederik Cilius og Mathias Hammer er holdkaptajnerne, der styrer aftenens to hold gennem udfordringerne. DR SymfoniOrkestret og dirigent Thomas Søndergård står for musikken, mens Phillip Faber er den oplagte vært, der forsøger at holde styr på løjerne.

programme.title: Luksus på skinner - Skotland
programme.desc: From Edinburgh to the Wild Highlands. Take Alan Cumming aboard the luxurious night train The Royal Scotsman, who runs 2000 guests every year through Scotland's most beautiful sights. Along the way on the adventurous journey, he experiences luxury, usually reserved for the royals, visits historic landmarks, sips champagne and explores iconic buildings - from coast to coast, from lake to mountain and all the way into the wilderness. / Fra Edinburgh til det vilde højland. Tag med Alan Cumming ombord på det luksuriøse nattog The Royal Scotsman, der hvert år kører 2000 gæster gennem Skotlands flotteste seværdigheder. Undervejs på den eventyrlige rejse oplever han luksus, der normalt er forbeholdt de royale, besøger historiske vartegn, sipper champagne og udforsker ikoniske bygninger - fra kyst til kyst, fra sø til bjerg og helt ud i vildmarken.

programme.title: En Kort En Lang
programme.desc: Jacob fries to Jørgen, who answers yes. But soon Jacob realizes that he is in love with Caroline, who is married to Jørgen's brother. It develops into an affair and Jacob has to make a difficult choice. / Jacob frier til Jørgen, som svarer ja. Men snart indser Jacob, at han er forelsket i Caroline, som er gift med Jørgens bror. Det udvikler sig til en affære, og Jacob må træffe et svært valg.

programme.desc: Sex, homosexuality and ethnicity. Comedy series holds a mirror in front of us, "Look what we are afraid of." From 'I Love Lucy' to 'Friends', the series reflects how the US is constantly changing. / Sex, homoseksualitet og etnicitet. Komedieserier holder et spejl op foran os: “Se, hvad vi er bange for.” Fra ‘I Love Lucy’ til ‘Venner’ afspejler serierne, hvordan USA er under konstant forandring.

programme.title: James Brown - Soulmusikkens gudfar
programme.desc: James Brown: The godfather of soul music is an American documentary series that depicts the iconic singer and musician James Brown's life - from an upbringing in poverty to a status as one of the world's most influential musicians. The series follows Brown's path to star status, where he both created the funk genre and became an important voice in the civil rights movement. His journey is characterized by triumphs and downs, from great success to battle with abuse and litigation. Through hard work and an indomitable will, he regained himself, leaving a deep legacy of African American music, which continues to inspire generations of artists in disco, dance, afrobeat and hip hop. / James Brown: Soulmusikkens gudfar er en amerikansk dokumentarserie, der skildrer den ikoniske sanger og musiker James Browns liv – fra en opvækst i fattigdom til en status som en af verdens mest indflydelsesrige musikere. Serien følger Browns vej mod stjernestatus, hvor han både skabte funkgenren og blev en vigtig stemme i borgerrettighedsbevægelsen. Hans rejse er præget af triumfer og nedture, fra stor succes til kamp med misbrug og retssager. Gennem hårdt arbejde og en ukuelig vilje genfandt han sig selv og efterlod en dyb arv inden for afroamerikansk musik, som fortsat inspirerer generationer af kunstnere inden for disco, dance, afrobeat og hiphop.

programme.title: Mysterierne om Danmarks dræbersygdomme
programme.desc: Journalist Asger Juhl and professor of epidemiology Lone Simonsen cast an investigative look at the epidemics that have hit Denmark over time. / Journalisten Asger Juhl og professor i epidemiologi Lone Simonsen kaster et undersøgende blik på de epidemier, som gennem tiden har ramt Danmark.

programme.title: Optimistens guide til planeten
programme.desc: Actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau seeks activists and researchers who develop innovative solutions to some of our biggest environmental challenges. / Skuespiller Nikolaj Coster-Waldau opsøger aktivister og forskere, der udvikler innovative løsninger på nogle af vores største miljøudfordringer.

programme.title: Jerusalem - Kampen om den hellige by
programme.desc: Temple Mountain, The Weeping Wall, Al-Aqsa Mosque and the Rock Mosque. Jerusalem is a center for three of the world's greatest religions: Judaism, Christianity and Islam. But how does the city's complex past affect the present? The series dives into six landmark conflicts in the city's history. The first episode follows Jerusalem's development from a small, isolated settlement without great importance to the holiest city of the Jewish people. / Tempelbjerget, Grædemuren, al-Aqsa-moskeen og Klippemoskeen. Jerusalem er et centrum for tre af verdens største religioner: jødedommen, kristendommen og islam. Men hvordan påvirker byens komplekse fortid nutiden? Serien dykker ned i seks skelsættende konflikter i byens historie. Første episode følger Jerusalems udvikling fra en lille, isoleret bosættelse uden stor betydning til det jødiske folks helligste by.

programme.title: Kleopatras hemmelige grav
programme.desc: Archaeologists may finally be close to finding Cleopatra's last resting place thanks to new discoveries. Take us with us and clarify the mysteries of this legendary queen. / Arkæologer er måske endelig tæt på at finde Kleopatras sidste hvilested takket være nye opdagelser. Tag med os, og opklar mysterierne om denne legendariske dronning.

programme.title: Picasso - Skønheden og udyret
programme.desc: He was one of the most important artists of the 20th century. Spanish painter Pablo Picasso was born in 1881. He revolutionized art history, experienced two world wars and portrayed a century filled with chaos, hope and despair. His art was often brutal, but also managed to capture beauty in suffering. In private, he was full of contradictions and left chaotic conditions - and art enough to fill a plane hangar. Here's his story. / Han var en af de vigtigste kunstnere i det 20. århundrede. Den spanske maler Pablo Picasso blev født i 1881. Han revolutionerede kunsthistorien, gennemlevede to verdenskrige og skildrede et århundrede fyldt med kaos, håb og fortvivlelse. Hans kunst var ofte brutal, men formåede også at indfange skønhed i lidelsen. Privat var han fuld af modsætninger og efterlod sig kaotiske forhold - og kunst nok til at fylde en flyhangar. Her er hans historie.

programme.title: DRS BEST - In short / DRs bedste - kort fortalt
programme.desc: We love getting close to the famous in talk shows, and then we need to know our culture to know ourselves. We can get to through TV. Here you get DR's best, in short. / Vi elsker at komme helt tæt på de kendte i talkshows, og så skal vi kende vores kultur for at kende os selv. Det kan vi bl.a. komme til gennem tv. Her får du DRs bedste, kort fortalt.

programme.title: Hells Angels bag rygmærket
programme.desc: Murder, drugs and fraternity. This series dives into the secrets of the most notorious and feared motorcycle club in the world - Hells Angels. Witnesses, former presidents of Hells Angels and undercover agents who have risked their lives to infiltrate the club, say for the first time about the criminal activities. / Mord, stoffer og broderskab. Denne serie dykker ned i hemmelighederne bag den mest berygtede og frygtede motorcykelklub i verden - Hells Angels. Vidner, tidligere præsidenter for Hells Angels og undercoveragenter, der har risikeret deres liv for at infiltrere klubben, udtaler sig for første gang om de kriminelle aktiviteter.

programme.title: En vild familie
programme.desc: On a small farm in the woods, Mary, Nik and the children are self -sufficient and have a home school. They live out their dream - but then the unexpected happens. Award -winning documentary. / På en lille gård i skoven er Maria, Nik og børnene selvforsørgende og har hjemmeskole. De udlever sin drømmen – men så sker det uventede. Prisvindende dokumentar.

programme.title: Mossad - Israeli's secret police / Mossad - Israels hemmelige politi
programme.desc: Mossad, Israel's secret police, are feared and notorious throughout the world. Since the country's founding, the organization's job has been to prevent a new Holocaust. Their bold and spectacular operations have always impressed and deterred Israel's enemies. For the task of agents is not only to collect information, they also have a license to kill. Here, senior Israeli sources tell the story of the powerful and controversial Mossad. / Mossad, Israels hemmelig politi, er frygtet og berygtet i hele verden. Siden landets grundlæggelse har organisationens job været at forhindre et nyt Holocaust. Deres dristige og spektakulære operationer har altid imponeret og afskrækket Israels fjender. For agenternes opgave er ikke blot at indsamle informationer, de har også licens til at dræbe. Her fortæller højtstående israelske kilder historien om det magtfulde og kontroversielle Mossad.

programme.title: Tilbage til fremtiden
programme.desc: Flying cars, colonies on Mars and machines that think for themselves - how did the future look like in the past? In this series, we travel back in time and dive into the past notions of the future. What hit the spot and what went completely wrong? And what does the future dreams reveal about the time they were created in? / Flyvende biler, kolonier på Mars og maskiner, der tænker selv - hvordan så fremtiden egentlig ud i fortiden? I denne serie rejser vi tilbage i tiden og dykker ned i tidligere tiders forestillinger om fremtiden. Hvad ramte plet, og hvad gik helt galt? Og hvad afslører fremtidsdrømmene om den tid, de blev skabt i?

programme.title: Spillet om magten
programme.desc: With Piet van Deurs we have to go back in time to the scene of a number of fateful games, and where a brave Danish king tonight emerges from the darkness of history in the company of an emperor, an old monk and - an elephant. / Vi skal med Piet van Deurs tilbage i tiden til åstedet for en række skæbnespil, og hvor en modig dansk konge i aften dukker frem af historiens mørke i selskab med en Kejser, en gammel munk og - en elefant.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam and Tusker have formed pairs for 20 years. They are more in love than ever and go on a trip in their motorhome through England. Two years ago, Tusker was diagnosed with early dementia and they know their time together is limited. As the journey progresses, it turns out that their wishes for the future are different, and they are both confronted with the question of what it really means to love each other. / Sam og Tusker har dannet par i 20 år. De er mere forelskede end nogensinde og drager på tur i deres autocamper gennem England. For to år siden blev Tusker diagnosticeret med tidlig demens, og de ved, at deres tid sammen er begrænset. Som rejsen skrider frem, viser det sig, at deres ønsker for fremtiden er forskellige, og de konfronteres begge med spørgsmålet om, hvad det egentlig betyder at elske hinanden.

programme.title: Close to the truth is investigating / Tæt på sandheden undersøger
programme.desc: In this new program series, Jonatan Spang comes close to the truth when he examines the new world order in which Europe is in with his reporter Sebastian Kanani. / I denne nye programserie kommer Jonatan Spang tæt på sandheden, når han med sin reporter Sebastian Kanani undersøger den nye verdensorden, som Europa befinder sig i.

programme.title: Under the Banner of Heaven
programme.desc: Criminal officer Pyre is investigating the murder of Brenda Wright Lafferty and her little daughter in a suburb of Salt Lake Valley and reveals buried truths that make him question his own faith. / Kriminalbetjent Pyre efterforsker mordet på Brenda Wright Lafferty og hendes lille datter i en forstad i Salt Lake Valley og afslører begravede sandheder, der får ham til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved sin egen tro.

programme.title: Boy Erased
programme.desc: Jared is the son of a Baptist priest in a conservative city. As his family finds out that he is gay, they force him to enter into a therapy program for the repentance of gays. / Jared er søn af en baptistpræst i en konservativ by. Da hans familie finder ud af at han er homoseksuel, tvinger de ham til at indgå i et terapiprogram for omvendelse af homoseksuelle.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen - Amerikas arbejderhelt
programme.desc: Bruce Springsteen is more than a rock star - he's an icon. For over 50 years he has been in the limelight and given a vote to the working class and described the United States in everything from tributes of the fatherland to protest songs. With over 130 million albums sold and legendary concerts, The Boss is a modest troubadour that unites literature, film and rocknroll - and shows us the true face of the United States. / Bruce Springsteen er mere end en rockstjerne - han er et ikon. I over 50 år har han været i rampelyset og givet stemme til arbejderklassen og beskrevet USA i alt fra hyldester af fædrelandet til protestsange. Med over 130 millioner solgte album og legendariske koncerter er The Boss en beskeden troubadour, der forener litteratur, film og rocknroll - og viser os USAs sande ansigt.

programme.title: I magtens korridorer
programme.desc: Politiske insidere og ledere afslører, hvordan Amerikas mest magtfulde har håndteret chokerende rapporter om folkedrab og krigsforbrydelser.

programme.title: Can’t Feel Nothing
programme.desc: The Internet has changed the world - it is clearly seen in the street scene, in public transport, in the school yard, etc., where most people have their eyes on their phones. But how has the Internet affected our inner life - our feelings and minds? This documentary focuses sharply on how people and businesses associated with the Internet - especially its darker corners - try to control our feelings to make money and what consequences it has. / Internettet har forandret verden - det ses tydeligt i gadebilledet, i den offentlige transport, i skolegården osv., hvor de fleste har blikket rettet mod deres telefoner. Men hvordan har internettet påvirket vores indre liv - vores følelser og sind?Denne dokumentar stiller skarpt på, hvordan personer og virksomheder med tilknytning til internettet - især dets mørkere afkroge - forsøger at kontrollere vores følelser for at tjene penge, og hvilke konsekvenser det har.

programme.title: Kleopatras hemmelige grav
programme.desc: Archaeologists may finally be close to finding Cleopatra's last resting place thanks to new discoveries. Take us with us and clarify the mysteries of this legendary queen. / Arkæologer er måske endelig tæt på at finde Kleopatras sidste hvilested takket være nye opdagelser. Tag med os, og opklar mysterierne om denne legendariske dronning.

programme.title: Julio Iglesias
programme.desc: The eyes are the most important thing in a beautiful woman. This is the opinion of butter tenor Julio Iglesias, who has fought women's hearts around the world. Before throwing himself over the music, he played football and was on target for Real Madrid. And in addition to the music, he has been involved in charity work for many years. Hear about it and much more in Jørgen de Mylius portrait of the Spanish singer. / Øjnene er det vigtigste hos en smuk kvinde. Det mener smørtenoren Julio Iglesias, der har besnæret kvindehjerter verden over. Inden han kastede sig over musikken, spillede han fodbold og stod på mål for Real Madrid. Og ved siden af musikken har han i mange år involveret sig i velgørenhedsarbejde. Hør om det og meget mere i Jørgen de Mylius portræt af den spanske sanger.

programme.title: Danske musiklegender
programme.desc: Pop icon Gitte Hænning tells in this portrait conversation about being thrown into fame as an eight -year -old, about first the collaboration and then the breakup with father Otto Hænning, about being a teen idol in both Denmark and Germany, about the victory in the German Melody Grand Prix in 1973 - the same year she moved permanently to her - about her love for jazz and about the reconciliation with her father. / Popikonet Gitte Hænning fortæller i denne portrætsamtale om at blive kastet ud i berømmelsen som otteårig, om først samarbejdet og siden bruddet med faderen Otto Hænning, om at være teen-idol i både Danmark og Tyskland, om sejren i det tyske Melodi Grand Prix i 1973 - samme år hun flyttede permanent dertil - om sin kærlighed til jazzen og om forsoningen med sin far.

programme.title: Depression
programme.sub-title: How do you get out again? / Wie kommt man wieder raus?
programme.desc: In tremendous, every five to sixth adults is affected once in the life of depression. Although a real hype experience in social media mentally: shame is still great - and the knowledge of the disease is low. Science journalist Frank Seibert meets those affected, therapists and researchers and asks: How well can a depression be recognized, diagnosed and treated? And how can it be possible to get out again? Are AI and Chatbots already so far that they can replace therapies? / Schatzungsweise jeder funfte bis sechste Erwachsene ist einmal im Leben von Depressionen betroffen. Obwohl in den sozialen Medien Mental Health einen regelrechten Hype erfahrt: Die Scham ist immer noch groSS - und das Wissen um die Erkrankung gering. Wissenschaftsjournalist Frank Seibert trifft Betroffene, Therapeutinnen, Ärzte und Forschende und fragt nach: Wie gut lasst sich eine Depression erkennen, diagnostizieren und behandeln? Und wie kann es gelingen, da wieder herauszukommen? Sind KI und Chatbots bereits so weit, dass sie Therapien ersetzen konnen?

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Party alarm for Hubert and Staller! They are called to a house of celebration of celebration for resting. There, Tina Geiger's hen party is in full swing. But instead of being mapped, the organizers of the evening, Caro Sendele and Anja Grobmeier, are very impressed by the police. You have ordered a stripper in a police uniform and now cheered the delivered double pack. But happy. Hubert and Staller clear the misunderstanding. Before the two can go, you will find a dead man in cheap, resembled police uniform at the foot of the basement staircase: stripper Stefan Meyer. According to pathological Dr. Anja Licht was clearly pounded and has injured himself. The three friends claim that they never saw the chic stripper. And the homeowner and husband Peter Sendele was said to be in the theater all evening. While Hubert and Staller try to find out who of the fours of the fours, Sonja Wirth follows several ads. Applied callers report loads through a drone that she filmed in flight around her house when showering or getting dressed. As one of the women also reports a burglary, there is suddenly a completely different thought in the room: Did the drone pilot not spy on women, but the Hauser to find prey there? When Martin Riedl wants to warn the other ladies that their house is in danger of burglary, he was surprised. Caro Sendele of all people also reported a drone. Did the two cases to do more than before? / Partyalarm fur Hubert und Staller! Wegen Ruhestorung werden sie zu einem Haus feierwutiger Frauen gerufen. Dort ist der Junggesellinnenabschied von Tina Geiger in vollem Gange. Doch statt verargert zu sein, sind die Organisatorinnen des Abends, Caro Sendele und Anja Grobmeier, vom Besuch der Polizei sehr angetan. Sie haben namlich einen Stripper in Polizeiuniform bestellt und bejubeln nun das gelieferte Doppelpack. Doch zu fruh gefreut. Hubert und Staller klaren das Missverstandnis auf. Bevor die beiden gehen konnen, finden sie am FuSSe der Kellertreppe einen toten Mann in billig nachgemachter Polizeiuniform: den Stripper Stefan Meyer. Laut Pathologin Dr. Anja Licht wurde er eindeutig gestoSSen und hat sich dabei todlich verletzt. Die drei Freundinnen behaupten, den schicken Stripper aber niemals zu Gesicht bekommen zu haben. Und auch der Hausbesitzer und Ehemann Peter Sendele war angeblich den ganzen Abend im Theater. Wahrend Hubert und Staller herauszufinden versuchen, wer von den Vieren lugt, geht Sonja Wirth mehreren Anzeigen nach. Die Grundidee ist bestechend: Mit harmlosem Salzwasser, das fein zerstaubt wird, will man die Wolken uber dem Meer heller machen, sodass sie mehr Sonnenlicht ins All zuruckstrahlen. Sie befasst sich mit der wohl umstrittensten Methode des Geoengineering, bei der Schwefeldioxid in der Stratosphare verteilt wird, um Sonnenstrahlen zuruckzuwerfen, bevor sie in die Erdatmosphare eindringen.Nicht nur fur der die Klimaforschung, auch fur das Militar ist Geoengineering langst ein Thema. Doch Hubert und Staller tun sich schwer, in der zerrutteten Familie ein Motiv fur die Tat zu finden. War Frau Strickler aus irgendeinem Grund auf die Hundesitterin eifersuchtig? programme.title: With burnout through the forest / Mit Burnout durch den Wald
programme.desc: These six people could hardly be more different, but the stress of her everyday life has been combined: the teacher Silvia (Stefanie Stappenbeck) has to come up with two children as a single mother and is now also plagued by a tinnitus in addition to money worries; The restless management consultant Johann (Max von Pufendorf) leads a life in the fast lane and sees every break as a wasted time; The publisher Alfred (Martin Brambach) has been unemployed for years and, after over 500 unsuccessful applications, humiliating temporary positions and frustrating appointments in the job center threatens to lose any courage to live; The young Rosa (Paula Kalenberg) is shining in a chic advertising agency from a badly paid internship and has no real perspective despite her burning ambition; Conversely, the newly baked pensioner Herbert (Walter Kreye) can look at a fully experienced professional life: he has accompanied people to death in a hospice for 40 years; Therefore, he knows about the finiteness of life and still liked many dreams and wishes. Unfortunately, his wife Gudrun (Jutta Speidel), who goes through life full of pessimism and for which every day only means one further step towards death. They have all gathered more or less voluntarily in a remote forest hotel in Markic Switzerland in order to find their mental balance far away from the hectic big city. However, Johann and Gudrun in particular are very willing to face their problems. It is also not easy for the other participants to leave everyday life behind. None of them still suspects which tricks and tricks the experienced therapist Hannah (Birge Schade) came up with to lure the illustrious troops out of the reserve. In strenuous hikes and camping nights in the middle of the forest, the stressed city should find themselves. But unfortunately, group therapy does not go as smoothly and stress -free as planned in the green. Soon the therapist Hannah no longer knows where her head is. / Diese sechs Menschen konnten unterschiedlicher kaum sein, aber der Stress ihres alltaglichen Lebens hat sie zusammengefuhrt: Die Lehrerin Silvia (Stefanie Stappenbeck) muss sich als alleinerziehende Mutter um zwei Kinder kummern und wird neben Geldsorgen nun auch von einem Tinnitus geplagt; der rastlose Unternehmensberater Johann (Max von Pufendorf) fuhrt ein Leben auf der Überholspur und betrachtet jede Pause als vergeudete Zeit; der Verlagslektor Alfred (Martin Brambach) wiederum ist seit Jahren arbeitslos und droht nach uber 500 erfolglosen Bewerbungen, demutigenden Aushilfsstellen und frustrierenden Terminen im Jobcenter jeden Lebensmut zu verlieren; die junge Rosa (Paula Kalenberg) hangelt sich in einer schicken Werbeagentur von einem mies bezahlten Praktikumsvertrag zum nachsten und hat trotz ihres brennenden Ehrgeizes keine echte Perspektive; umgekehrt kann der frischgebackene Rentner Herbert (Walter Kreye) auf ein erfulltes Berufsleben zuruckblicken: Er hat 40 Jahre lang Menschen in einem Hospiz in den Tod begleitet; daher weiSS er um die Endlichkeit des Lebens und mochte sich noch viele Traume und Wunsche erfullen. Ganz anders leider seine Frau Gudrun (Jutta Speidel), die voller Pessimismus durchs Leben geht und fur die jeder Tag nur einen weiteren Schritt in Richtung Tod bedeutet. Sie alle haben sich mehr oder weniger freiwillig in einem abgelegenen Waldhotel in der Markischen Schweiz eingefunden, um fern der hektischen GroSSstadt ihr seelisches Gleichgewicht wiederzufinden. Allerdings sind vor allem Johann und Gudrun wenig gewillt, sich ihren Problemen zu stellen. Auch den anderen Teilnehmern fallt es nicht leicht, den Alltag hinter sich zu lassen. Noch ahnt keiner von ihnen, welche Tricks und Kniffe sich die erfahrene Therapeutin Hannah (Birge Schade) ausgedacht hat, um die illustre Truppe aus der Reserve zu locken. Bei anstrengenden Wanderungen und Camping-Nachten mitten im Wald sollen die gestressten Stadter zu sich selbst finden. Aber ganz so reibungslos und stressfrei wie geplant verlauft die Gruppentherapie im Grunen leider doch nicht. Bald weiSS die Therapeutin Hannah vor lauter Chaos selbst nicht mehr, wo ihr der Kopf steht.

programme.title: Das Gewinnerlos
programme.desc: Six correct ones in the lottery! If that is not a luck for Georg Freudenreich (Matthias Habich). Because everything can stay the way it is. But is that still possible? / Martin Sommer, Burgermeister von Lauterbronn, hat Probleme. Das Kleinstadtchen im Taubertal ist idyllisch, aber strukturschwach und stark von der Landwirtschaft abhangig. Je mehr Betriebe verloren gehen, desto groSSer werden die Sorgen des alleinerziehenden Vaters einer Teenagertochter um die Zukunft des Ortes und die kommunalen Finanzen. programme.desc: Heated asphalt and concrete are increasingly becoming a problem in German city. Ob Unternehmen mit groSSen Werksgelanden, Schulhofe, Parkplatze - die "ARD Story" zeigt, wie wir unsere Stadte vor einem Hitzekollaps retten konnten.Die Filmemacherinnen Gesine Enwaldt und Melanie Stucke machen sich auf die Suche nach dem verlorenen Grun und setzen gemeinsam mit "Frag den Staat" eine groSSe Daten-Recherche auf: Forscherinnen spuren auf, welchen Anteil Baume am Stadtbild haben. Acht besonders versiegelte und besonders heiSSe Stadte nehmen die Wissenschaftlerinnen unter die Lupe.AuSSerdem begleiten die beiden u. a. den Mannheimer Pflegedienstleiter Ilyas Demiroglu, der an Hitzetagen dafur sorgt, dass seine Patienten den Sommer uberstehen. Dabei setzt auch ihm die Hitze zu. Mithilfe modernster Messtechnik dokumentieren die Autorinnen, wie sich Hitzetage im Korper von Ilyas Demiroglu auswirken.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.desc: Julia is a principal at a Realschule Plus in Idar-Oberstein and teacher of a "Koa" class. "Koa" stands for "not without a degree" and is the Rhineland-Palatinate model to be able to graduate from school and thus enable the start of a job. But how do you bring school dropouts: inside and young people who - maybe even several times - have stayed seated, to work with the school and even write a inspection? Julia teaches the first "Koa" class at her school. Nationwide, more than 50,000 young people end school without a degree, the number has been similar for years. In Rhineland-Palatinate, the number of schoolmen has increased to almost eight percent in the past few years. The region around Idar-Oberstein is particularly affected, where Julia teaches her "KoA" class. Will she all bring about a school leaving certificate this school year? / Julia ist Konrektorin an einer Realschule Plus in Idar-Oberstein und Lehrerin einer "KoA"-Klasse. "KoA" steht fur "Keine/r ohne Abschluss" und ist das rheinland-pfalzische Modell, um moglichst vielen Schulabganger:innen doch noch einen Schulabschluss und damit den Start in einen Beruf zu ermoglichen. Doch wie bringt man Schulabbrecher:innen und Jugendliche, die - vielleicht sogar schon mehrmals - sitzengeblieben sind, dazu, in der Schule mitzuarbeiten und sogar eine Prufung zu schreiben? Julia unterrichtet die erste "KoA"-Klasse an ihrer Schule. Bundesweit mehr als 50.000 Jugendliche beenden jahrlich die Schule ohne Abschluss, die Zahl ist seit Jahren ahnlich hoch. In Rheinland-Pfalz ist die Zahl der Schuler:innen, die die Schule ohne Abschluss verlassen, in den vergangenen Jahren auf fast acht Prozent gestiegen. Die Region um Idar-Oberstein ist besonders betroffen, dort, wo Julia ihre "KoA"-Klasse unterrichtet. Wird sie in diesem Schuljahr alle zu einem Schulabschluss bringen?

programme.title: To the last drop - the documentary / Bis zum letzten Tropfen - Die Doku
programme.desc: The documentary is based on exclusive research that has been incorporated into the television film of the same name. The award -winning author Daniel Harry shows the reality behind the fiction: For years, an international drink company has come to open up a large groundwater reservoir for his feeding system near Luneburg. The water is so deep that the group and the conditional authorities assume that the drinking water supply to the population is not attacked. The group referred to an expert opinion that it has submitted to confirm the harmlessness of the water withdrawal. But there have been doubts about that. A local burger initiative does not trust the report. She wants to stop the ongoing approval process. "We don't sell!" And "There is no planet B" on their posters. With the help of scientists, Daniel Harrich explores how critically the situation could become due to the planned pumping of the water supply. The filmmaker will focus on a number of worrying new data and knowledge. Harrich accompanies the groundwater okologist PD Dr. Hans Jurgen Hahn from the University Koblenz-Landau, which examines the connection between surface and groundwater. His concern: The removal of groundwater can affect the water balance at the surface due to climate change. The case shows what is imminent to everyone if there are increasingly distribution struggles for the scarce groundwater supply. In short: who does the drinking water belong? During the filming, the group announces that he now wants to hire the project that he has "followed with great effort" for the time being. Grounding: The mineral water market has developed back. The burger initiative explains on request that it considers this information to be a tactical move. How the dispute over the water near Luneburg runs out remains open. (Stand from 2022) / Die Doku beruht auf exklusiven Recherchen, die in den gleichnamigen Fernsehfilm eingeflossen sind. Der preisgekronte Autor Daniel Harrich zeigt die Wirklichkeit hinter der Fiktion: Jahrelang hat ein internationaler Getrankekonzern sich bemuht, fur seine Abfullanlage bei Luneburg ein groSSes Grundwasserreservoir zu erschlieSSen. Das Wasser liegt so tief, dass der Konzern und die zustandigen Behorden davon ausgehen, dass die Trinkwasserversorgung der Bevolkerung nicht angegriffen wird. Der Konzern hat auf ein von ihm vorgelegtes Gutachten verwiesen, das die Unbedenklichkeit der Wasserentnahme bestatigen soll. Doch daran gibt es schon lange Zweifel. Eine ortliche Burgerinitiative traut dem Gutachten nicht. Sie will das laufende Genehmigungsverfahren stoppen. "Wir verkaufen nicht!" und "Es gibt keinen Planet B" steht auf ihren Plakaten. Daniel Harrich geht mit Hilfe von Wissenschaftlern der Frage nach, wie kritisch die Lage durch das geplante Abpumpen der Wasservorrate tatsachlich werden konnte. Dabei stoSSt der Filmemacher auf eine Reihe von besorgniserregenden neuen Daten und Erkenntnissen. Harrich begleitet den Grundwasserokologen PD Dr. Hans Jurgen Hahn von der Universitat Koblenz-Landau, der den Zusammenhang zwischen Oberflachen- und Grundwasser untersucht. Seine Sorge: Die Entnahme von Grundwasser kann sich, bedingt durch den Klimawandel, fatal auf den Wasserhaushalt an der Oberflache auswirken. Der Fall zeigt, was uns allen bevorsteht, wenn es zunehmend Verteilungskampfe um die knapper werdenden Grundwasservorrate gibt. Kurz gesagt: Wem gehort das Trinkwasser? Wahrend der Dreharbeiten kundigt der Konzern an, dass er das Vorhaben, das er "jahrelang mit groSSer Anstrengung verfolgt hat", nun "vorerst" einstellen will. Begrundung: Der Mineralwassermarkt habe sich rucklaufig entwickelt. Die Burgerinitiative erklart auf Anfrage, sie halte diese Ankundigung fur einen taktischen Schachzug. Wie der Streit um das Wasser bei Luneburg ausgeht, bleibt demnach moglicherweise weiter offen. (Stand aus dem Jahr 2022)

programme.title: The account - part 2 / Das Konto - Teil 2
programme.desc: From one day to the other, the life of the successful manager Michael Muhlhausen (Heino Ferch) has changed radically. First of all, the group management rejects its fundamentally prepared project of an enemy takeover of the most important competitive company without justification. Then the chief chemist Osterwald (Michael Gwisdek) is found shot - and a cleverly launched network of indications interprets Muhlhausen as a tider. The lawyer Laura Spiegelberg (Franziska Petri) wants to help him prove his innocence and is also murdered. On the escape from the police, Muhlhausen will receive unexpected help from the Polish Mafioso Pawel Sikorsky (Hermann Beyer), who hopes to get into the business in this way. When Muhlhausen contacts his wife Charlotte (Julia Jager), he has to take another jerk: Charlotte had an affarity with the murdered Osterwald. In the secret apartment, both used for their rendezvous, Charlotte finds documents that show that Osterwald should contaminate the products of the competition with a specially breeded salmonella culture. Funke AG ruined thereby a snap compared to Muhlhausen's conventional takeover tarpaulins. In the attempt, company boss Dr. Charlotte is also murdered to warn Funke (Hansjurgen hurrig). Muhlhausen now has to pull his head out of the loop and at the same time prevent a Europe -wide food scandal. / Von einem Tag auf den anderen hat sich das Leben des erfolgreichen Managers Michael Muhlhausen (Heino Ferch) radikal geandert. Zunachst lehnt die Konzernleitung sein grundlich vorbereitetes Projekt einer feindlichen Übernahme des wichtigsten Konkurrenzunternehmens ohne Begrundung ab. Dann wird der Chefchemiker Osterwald (Michael Gwisdek) erschossen aufgefunden - und ein geschickt lanciertes Netz von Indizien deutet auf Muhlhausen als Tater. Die Anwaltin Laura Spiegelberg (Franziska Petri) will ihm helfen, seine Unschuld zu beweisen, und wird ebenfalls ermordet. Auf der Flucht vor der Polizei erhalt Muhlhausen unerwartete Hilfe von dem polnischen Mafioso Pawel Sikorsky (Hermann Beyer), der auf diese Weise ins Geschaft zu kommen hofft. Als Muhlhausen Kontakt mit seiner Frau Charlotte (Julia Jager) aufnimmt, muss er einen weiteren Ruckschlag einstecken: Charlotte hatte eine Affare mit dem ermordeten Osterwald. In der geheimen Wohnung, die beide fur ihre Rendezvous nutzten, findet Charlotte Unterlagen, aus denen hervorgeht, dass Osterwald die Produkte der Konkurrenz mit einer speziell gezuchteten Salmonellenkultur verseuchen sollte. Die dadurch ruinierte Funke AG ware ein Schnappchen im Vergleich zu Muhlhausens konventionellen Übernahmeplanen. Bei dem Versuch, Firmenchef Dr. Funke (Hansjurgen Hurrig) zu warnen, wird auch Charlotte ermordet. Muhlhausen muss nun seinen Kopf aus der Schlinge ziehen und gleichzeitig einen europaweiten Lebensmittelskandal verhindern.

The past has left deep traces. / Ein alter Fall Finn Kiesewetters erfahrt neue Brisanz: Bei StraSSenarbeiten wird die Leiche eines jungen Madchens gefunden, das vor 15 Jahren nach einem Klassenfest spurlos verschwand. Da Finn sich all die Jahre Vorwurfe gemacht hat, dass er den Fall nicht aufklaren konnte, geht er mit besonderer Empathie an die Ermittlung. Die gerichtsmedizinischen Untersuchungen ergeben, dass Leonie Faber an den Folgen einer Schadelverletzung starb. Sie trug den Schlussel zu einem Saal der Zeugen Jehovas und einen Liebesbrief bei sich, den ihr der geheimnisvolle "S." geschrieben hat. Hatte Leonie am Abend ihres Verschwindens noch ein Date? Ein damaliger Verehrer, der inzwischen einschlagig vorbestrafte Salvatore Rinaldi, ergreift sofort die Flucht, als die Kommissare ihn vernehmen wollen. Aber nicht nur Rinaldi hat etwas zu verbergen, auch andere Klassenkameraden und die Eltern des Madchens, Angehorige der Zeugen Jehovas, huten seit 15 Jahren ihre Geheimnisse. Die Vergangenheit hat tiefe Spuren hinterlassen.
